name: Business Ownership
overview: Scripture teaches that business ownership and the pursuit of wealth are gifts and opportunities granted by God, who empowers His people to gain wealth in accordance with His covenant (Deuteronomy 8:18). Believers are reminded that they cannot serve both God and money, emphasizing the importance of prioritizing God's kingdom and righteousness above material gain (Matthew 6:24, 6:33). In all business endeavors, Christians are called to act wholeheartedly and with gratitude, doing everything in the name of the Lord Jesus rather than for human approval (Colossians 3:17, 3:23). Additionally, respect and obedience in relationships related to business, such as between servants and masters, reflect the biblical ethic of honoring authority and pleasing others as a testimony of faith (Titus 2:9).
